description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Fiend Hunter, adding {R}.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan to the battlefield from exile.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Repeat.
